plugins.prepareCmd: sed -i.bak 's/^AWSP_VERSION=".*"/AWSP_VERSION="${nextRelease.version}"/' bin/awsp.sh && rm bin/awsp.sh.bak && sed -i.bak 's/^$global:AWSP_VERSION = ".*"/$global:AWSP_VERSION = "${nextRelease.version}"/' bin/awsp.ps1 && rm bin/awsp.ps1.bak

plugins.successComment: This ${issue.pull_request ? 'PR is included' : 'issue has been resolved'} in version ${nextRelease.version} :tada:

plugins.changelogTitle:
# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.
